name: Facet
text: Choose a single dark theme with a persistent one-click toggle to light mode. High contrast colors ensure visibility and reduce eye strain during long sessions, aligning with competitive analysis findings. The toggle respects user preference without cluttering the interface, keeping focus on data. Trade-off: light mode may feel less immersive for some users, but the toggle ensures accessibility without sacrificing the primary dark theme’s benefits.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A persistent one-click toggle still risks users getting stuck in the wrong mode—some won’t notice the toggle, others will toggle too late. Better: a system that remembers the user’s last mode per session and defaults to it, with a subtle indicator if the mode changes unexpectedly. Settle it with a quick usability test: measure how often users toggle back after an unintended mode switch.
